summary: Touchstone Semiconductor is a company founded in 2010 by semiconductor industry experts who previously worked at Maxim Integrated Products, Linear Technology and Analog Devices. It raised $12M in Series A funding from Opus Capital and Khosla Ventures. The note states its headquarters were in Milpitas, California.
one_line: Touchstone Semiconductor, a semiconductor company founded in 2010 by former Maxim, Linear Technology and Analog Devices experts and headquartered in Milpitas, California.
key_facts: Touchstone Semiconductor was founded by a group of semiconductor industry experts from Maxim Integrated Products, Linear Technology and Analog Devices.
Touchstone Semiconductor received $12M in Series A funding.
The Series A funding for Touchstone Semiconductor came from Opus Capital and Khosla Ventures.
The headquarters of Touchstone Semiconductor were located in Milpitas, California.
